prompt: Create a photorealistic street-fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman in an all-black outfit sitting on a weathered wooden bench outside an old stone building. She is absorbed in reading a small paperback book, looking downward with a calm, introspective expression. She wears oversized black over-ear headphones, a loose black hooded sweatshirt layered under a black oversized utility jacket, faded charcoal wide-leg jeans, and chunky black lace-up combat boots with thick platform soles. Her black hair is loosely tied in a messy bun with wispy bangs framing her face. One knee is raised on the bench while the other leg stretches forward, creating a relaxed urban pose. Place one compact patterned black-and-gray crossbody bag beside her on the bench. The setting is a muted city exterior with aged cream stone walls, a dark distressed wooden window frame with glass panes behind her, worn bench slats, and gray pavement. Use a subdued monochrome black-and-charcoal wardrobe palette, natural overcast daylight, soft shadows, realistic fabric texture, scuffed wood, slightly desaturated tones, shallow depth of field, and editorial fashion photography composition in a vertical 3:4 frame. No visible logos, no readable text on the book, no extra people, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张照片级写实的街头时尚肖像，描绘一位年轻的东亚女性，身着全黑服装，坐在古老石建筑外的一张风化木长椅上。她正沉浸在阅读一本小型平装书，低头看着书本，表情平静而内敛。她戴着超大号黑色头戴式耳机，宽松的黑色连帽卫衣内搭在黑色超大号工装夹克里，穿着褪色的炭灰色阔腿牛仔裤，以及厚底黑色系带马丁靴。她的 black 头发随意地扎成凌乱的丸子头，几缕碎发垂在脸颊两侧。她的一只膝盖抬起放在长椅上，另一条腿向前伸展，呈现出一种放松的都市姿态。长椅旁放着一个紧凑的黑灰图案斜挎包。背景是柔和的城市外观，有着陈旧的奶油色石墙、她身后深色且斑驳的木质窗框及玻璃窗、磨损的长椅板和灰色人行道。采用低调的黑炭色单色调服装配色，自然阴天光线，柔和的阴影，真实的织物纹理，磨损的木材，略微去饱和的色调，浅景深，以及竖向 3:4 画幅的编辑时尚摄影构图。画面中无可见标志，书上无可见文字，无额外人物，无水印。
